one_line: Short synced subtitles with enlarged key words over calm top-down, hands-only footage.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down on kraft paper: an open purple watercolour tray, then a brush jar and a white sheet as the camera drifts. Voiceover (transcript): "רגע לפני שנת הלימודים התחילה". First text at 0:01: "רגע לפני".
q1_hook.why: Voice and text open together and the headline builds from 0:01 (H6, T3), over a colourful tray. But it names a time, not a benefit, and the exercise is only clear around 0:09, with no cut before 0:04 (H2, H1). A voice opens, but no face does (H4).

beats.what: Slow drift over the open paint tray, jar and blank sheet; text builds: "זה זמן טוב להאט" "יחד"
beats.why: Calm, colourful, timed to the first sentence

beats.what: Pencil draws two overlapping circles; "השתמשתי בצבעי המים של ג'יאוטו"
beats.why: Names the product and the simple task

beats.what: Wide brush wets the paper; "נניח שכבת מים על הדף"
Purple loaded and dabbed in circle one; brush rinsed, jar turns purple; "בראשון נחשוב על החופש שהיה"
beats.why: Shifts from technique to a feeling prompt

beats.what: Close-ups: purple, orange, pink bloom in circle one; text "שמגיעה"
Green, blue, yellow in circle two; "להיפגש", "מהקווים" enlarged; colour crosses the pencil line
beats.why: The idea of the exercise made visible

beats.what: Colours merge across the overlap; "הילדים וגם אנחנו מגיעים לשנה החדשה"
beats.why: Spoken meaning lands on the finished blend

beats.what: Finished painting held top-down; last words at 0:44, a few seconds of picture only

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. The caption invites trying the activity together ("יצירה פשוטה שאפשר לעשות יחד עם הילדים"), with no question, comment word, save, send or tag ask.
q2_flow.why: Two circles for the summer and the year ahead give a small arc with the merge held for the end (K2, R4). Technique is wrapped in a feeling, not a dry list (K4, R3). But the first colour is at 0:14 and about 4 s of silent hold close it (R1). 49 s suits one demo (R2).

q3_cta.what: None in the video, none in the caption. The caption only invites ("אפשר לעצור יחד", "יצירה פשוטה שאפשר לעשות יחד עם הילדים"). Brand tag "בשיתוף @giotto_israel" is a disclosure, not an ask.
q3_cta.why: Zero asks keeps the sell light and fits the calm tone (C7, C1). The cost is a dead end: no save, send, comment or follow prompt, and no way to find the paints. A reusable exercise like this could earn saves, but nothing says so (R7).

q4_shown.what: The open paint tray at 0:00 and again at 0:12, 0:18, 0:26; a brush handle reading GIOTTO at 0:16; one adult's hands drawing, wetting, painting and rinsing; blooming colour close up; the finished painting at the end. No child, no face, no price.
q4_shown.why: The product is on screen at 0:00 but first handled only at 0:12, so it misses the 2 s mark (S1). It then returns several times, with the brand named once in speech and text, a light pulse (H3, C7). Hands only carry it (S4). "השתמשתי" is first-hand use (S6).

q5_edit.what: 14 shots in 49 s, about 3.5 s, straight cuts, no speed changes seen. A slow camera drift in the first 4 s, close-ups from 0:18. Subtitles cut line by line with the voice, key word enlarged. Voice ends 0:45, then a silent picture-only close.
q5_edit.why: Cuts follow each step at a moderate pace, but the first cut is at 4 s (E2, E1). Short chunks timed to speech work for sound off and sound on (E4, T2). It ends on the finished painting, with a short quiet tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A guided end-of-summer art exercise: one circle for the summer that passed, one for the year ahead, colours meeting. Serves a parent wanting a calm, shared activity before school.
q6_topic.why: It meets a real parenting moment, the start of the school year, with warmth and no hype (K6, K7). The feeling is calm and reflective, not a high-arousal peak (K1). Practical steps are wrapped in feelings, as K4 advises.

q7_filmed.what: Phone looking down at a table covered in kraft paper, wide at first, then close-ups of the paper with the brush; slight handheld movement and an angled sheet at the end; adult hands only, no face; bright natural light.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands put the viewer in the painter's seat (F5). The paint fills the frame in close-ups, so colour reads on a phone (F4). All live motion (F8), sharp and lit but clearly homemade (F7). Vertical and full-screen (F1).

q8_text.on_screen: Burned-in white bold Hebrew subtitles with a shadow, no box, centred about half way down, over the painting. Chunks of 2 to 5 words synced to the voice: "רגע לפני" (0:01), "זה זמן טוב להאט" with "יחד" large (0:04), "שמגיעה" large (0:21), "להיפגש" (0:26), "מהקווים" (0:30). Text stops at 0:44. No headline card, no CTA.
q8_text.caption: "רגע לפני שהחופש נגמר, אפשר לעצור יחד". About 40 words: a reflective line, "יצירה פשוטה שאפשר לעשות יחד עם הילדים", the partner line "בשיתוף @giotto_israel", then 4 hashtags. No question, no CTA.
q8_text.why: Subtitling the whole voice lets a muted viewer follow (T1), in short chunks with a few enlarged key words (T2). Text sits inside the safe zone, over the painting (T4). The first caption line is seasonal, not a keyword line; hashtags are specific (T7). The partner line is in the body (T8).

weak_points: No promise or result before 0:14; subtitles repeat nearly the whole voice over the picture; no ask or next step; the brand barely appears; the emotional frame is about the exercise, not the product.
lumebook_takeaway: Film top-down, hands only, in calm light: pair a soft feeling prompt with the open book and turning pages, with short synced subtitles and one big key word.
not_verified: The exact product name (the tray label is not legible; Giotto appears on a brush handle and in the voice and subtitle). Whether the voice is the creator's. Music or natural sound. Her professional credentials (from the handle and a hashtag only). Correction to coded file: the burned-in subtitle at 0:04 reads "להאט", the transcript's "להיעט" is a mishearing.
